notes.title: Added new level
notes.content:
Hello, guys!
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33633941/a5f588dba0fe66559297209b2571d6f2f48e1785.png[/img]
[i]Above is a screenshot from level editor.[/i]

Added new level in desert. Two paths, different sets of enemies. The game became even more closer to the release!

Currently working on controls. Finally, first time in my games, you will be able to change controls! :D

Also, making it available to translate into different languages.

Stay on touch,
FlyingIslandsTeam
